intake_1.text: What result(s) do you want to achieve?

options.label: Generate revenue (increase revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, or cost savings)
Align with corporate strategy, goals, or KPIs
I have a cool idea or project

intake_2.text: What are you working on right now as it relates to innovation?

options.label: Pitch or launch a pilot or project internally
Build or evaluate an innovation portfolio of opportunities or projects
I have been assigned this task or objective

I'm curious about innovation and want to learn more

intake_4.text: What about innovation are you most curious about?

intake_5.text: What prompted you to reach out today?
